blocks.text: In a city where history, food, and everyday life unfold along the same streets, Birkenstock is inviting Cebuanos to slow down and experience Cebu on foot. On September 30, 2026, the footwear brand marked the opening of its newly relocated branch at Ayala Center Cebu, now located near the mall’s main atrium, with the local launch of “Philippines by Foot.” The afternoon brought Birkenstock’s global “Walk Naturally” philosophy to Cebu through heritage, food, and exploration.
